GameplayGearAttachmentSlotSet.description: GameplayGearAttachmentSlotSet defines the candidate items for one character attachment slot.

discreteItemSets.description: DiscreteItemSets are the weighted alternative items that may occupy this slot.

slotName.description: SlotName is the inventory slot name from CfgSlots, such as `Body`, `Back`, or `shoulderL`.

GameplayGearComplexChild.description: GameplayGearComplexChild defines an item created inside a selected parent item or cargo loadout, with optional nested simple cargo.

attributes.description: Attributes supplies the health and quantity ranges rolled for this item.

itemType.description: ItemType is the game class name of the nested item to create.

quickBarSlot.description: QuickBarSlot assigns the item to a quickbar slot; -1 leaves it unassigned.

simpleChildrenTypes.description: SimpleChildrenTypes are game class names of items created inside this item without per-child settings.

simpleChildrenUseDefaultAttributes.description: SimpleChildrenUseDefaultAttributes makes simple child items inherit the attributes from this item instead of using configuration defaults.

GameplayGearDiscreteItemSet.description: GameplayGearDiscreteItemSet defines one weighted item choice and any cargo or attachments created inside it.

attributes.description: Attributes supplies the health and quantity ranges rolled for this item.

complexChildrenTypes.description: ComplexChildrenTypes are items created inside the selected item, each with its own attributes, quickbar assignment, and optional simple cargo.

itemType.description: ItemType is the game class name of the item created in this slot.

quickBarSlot.description: QuickBarSlot assigns the item to a quickbar slot; -1 leaves it unassigned.

simpleChildrenTypes.description: SimpleChildrenTypes are game class names of child items created inside the selected item without per-child settings.

simpleChildrenUseDefaultAttributes.description: SimpleChildrenUseDefaultAttributes makes simple child items inherit the attributes from this item set instead of using configuration defaults.

spawnWeight.description: SpawnWeight is this item's relative selection weight among alternatives for the slot or set. It must be at least 1.

GameplayGearItemAttributes.description: GameplayGearItemAttributes defines the inclusive numeric ranges from which item health and quantity are selected during spawning.

healthMax.description: HealthMax is the upper bound for the spawned item's health value.

healthMin.description: HealthMin is the lower bound for the spawned item's health value.

quantityMax.description: QuantityMax is the upper bound for the spawned item's quantity value.

quantityMin.description: QuantityMin is the lower bound for the spawned item's quantity value.

GameplayGearPreset.description: GameplayGearPreset defines the character classes, equipment slots, and cargo variants available for one starting loadout.

attachmentSlotItemSets.description: AttachmentSlotItemSets defines weighted equipment choices for character attachment slots such as body, back, and shoulders.

characterTypes.description:
CharacterTypes lists survivor classes eligible for this preset.
When omitted or empty, the character type selected in the creation menu is used.

discreteUnsortedItemSets.description: DiscreteUnsortedItemSets defines weighted cargo loadouts added to the character independently of a specific attachment slot.

name.description: Name labels the preset for identification in configuration and logs.

spawnWeight.description:
SpawnWeight is the preset's relative selection weight.
It must be at least 1; higher values make the preset more likely to be selected.

GameplayGearPresetsFile.description: GameplayGearPresetsFile defines character equipment presets loaded through `cfggameplay.json -> PlayerData.spawnGearPresetFiles`.

GameplayGearUnsortedSet.description: GameplayGearUnsortedSet defines one weighted cargo loadout that can be selected independently of a character attachment slot.

attributes.description: Attributes provides default health and quantity ranges for nested items that inherit attributes from this set.

complexChildrenTypes.description: ComplexChildrenTypes are cargo items with their own attributes, quickbar assignment, and optional simple child items.

name.description: Name identifies the cargo loadout in configuration and diagnostics.

simpleChildrenTypes.description: SimpleChildrenTypes are game class names of cargo items created without per-item settings.

simpleChildrenUseDefaultAttributes.description: SimpleChildrenUseDefaultAttributes makes simple child items inherit the attributes from this cargo set instead of using configuration defaults.

spawnWeight.description: SpawnWeight is this cargo loadout's relative selection weight among alternatives. It must be at least 1.
